benchmarkDefinition.candidateUniverse: Must match the rule frozen in manifest.discoveryPolicy.postOutcomeMissAudit.candidateUniverse.
benchmarkDefinition.candidateRule: Must match the pre-registered outcome-based case rule; do not hand-pick memorable winners.
benchmarkDefinition.causalEligibilityRule: A case only counts as a detectable miss when pre-cutoff evidence could have supported a causal thesis without future information.
